name: dev.fly.tallyforge-quant-signals/quant-signals
title: TallyForge Quant Signals
description: Pay-per-call (x402) crypto research: regime, backtests, volatility, correlations, perp funding.

tools.name: market_preview_free
tools.description: FREE live preview (no payment required): returns spot price, 1d/7d change, 30d volatility, RSI14 and regime label for BTC, ETH or SOL from Coinbase public data, plus links to all 34-asset paid endpoints.

tools.name: market_regime_snapshot
tools.description: Returns a current market regime read for a major crypto asset from free public daily data: trend (SMA20/50/200), momentum (RSI14), realized volatility state, 1/7/30/90-day change, 1-year range and drawdown, plus a one-line summary.

symbol.description: Crypto ticker quoted in USD on Coinbase, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL

tools.name: walkforward_backtest_summary
tools.description: Runs a fee-aware walk-forward test of a long-only SMA crossover strategy on up to ~900 days of daily data for a major crypto asset (re-optimized on 180 days, tested on the next 60) and returns out-of-sample return vs buy-and-hold, per-fold results and a pass/fail verdict.

symbol.description: Crypto ticker quoted in USD on Coinbase, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL

fee_bps.description: Trading fee per side in basis points (0-100). Default 10.

tools.name: volatility_snapshot
tools.description: Realized volatility for a major crypto asset: 7/30/90-day annualized close-to-close vol, 30-day Parkinson (high-low) vol, ATR14 as % of price, where today's 30-day vol sits in its 1-year range (percentile, low/normal/high), whether vol is expanding or contracting, and 1-sigma expected moves for 1/7/30 days. Useful for position sizing and stop placement.

symbol.description: Crypto ticker quoted in USD on Coinbase, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL

tools.name: correlation_matrix
tools.description: Pearson correlation matrix of daily log returns for 2-8 major crypto assets over a 30, 90 or 180-day window, with the most and least correlated pairs, annualized volatility per asset and beta vs BTC when BTC is included. Useful for diversification checks and pair selection.

tools.name: perp_funding_snapshot
tools.description: Live perpetual-futures positioning for a major crypto asset from Hyperliquid public data: current hourly funding and its annualized rate, 24h and 7d average funding, mark vs oracle basis, open interest and 24h volume in USD, and a crowded-long/short read.

symbol.description: Crypto ticker quoted in USD on Coinbase, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL
